name: v1.39.8 - MMR normalize query vector Fix, Multi-tenant collections re-vectorize check on PATCH
body:
## Breaking Changes 
*none*

## New Features
*none*

## Fixes
* fix: MMR normalize query vector by @trengrj in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13227
* fix(auth): clear db user login cache on snapshot restore by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13278
* Stop backup endpoints from exposing collections the caller cannot access by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13274
* hnsw: fix commit log crash loop after a kill during heavy writes by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13295
* fix: named vector tombstone interval by @trengrj in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13203
* fix(dynamic): recover shared compressed bucket after an interrupted quantized upgrade (#451) by @abdelr in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13220
* Batch delete follow-ups: rate-limit unreadable-row warning, fix limit<=0 description by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13254
* Skip re-indexing unchanged text on update and keep len() filters current by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13288
* Delete WAL files with less than 4 bytes by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13297
* Namespaces: Fix issues around references by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13304
* hnsw: never apply garbage from a corrupt compacted commit log segment by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13300
* test(lsmkv): stop the flush cycle before Shutdown in the threshold tests by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13332
* feat(metrics): tracking of requested consistency level in all API requests by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13338
* fix(rbac): skip & log instead of erroring in `PoliciesToPermissions` and `CasbinPolicies` by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13281
* fix(multi2vec-google): route gemini-embedding-2 on Vertex AI to global :embedContent by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13340
* rest search: add the near-vector endpoint by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13265
* Validate input for authz handlers by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13294
* feat(monitoring): add `collection_namespace` label to usage metrics by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12833
* shard: fix vectorQueueSize and cold shard loading on the shards status endpoint by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13349
* Expose license state via /v1/meta, metrics, and startup log by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13092
* fix(cluster/rpc): don't abort in-flight RPCs on leader change by @moogacs in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13354
* metric(cluster): label leader-query failures by @moogacs in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13353
* fix(objects): pass the tenant to the re-vectorize check on PATCH by @ColtonRobak in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13345
* Update wl license text per legal (M3.5) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13360
* Fix two db user bugs by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13356

## New Contributors
* @ColtonRobak made their first contribution in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13345

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/compare/v1.39.7...v1.39.8
